input.prompt:
Animate the supplied running-legs starting image as one continuous photorealistic 16:9 shot. Riley is an ordinary commuter running LEFT TO RIGHT along the platform at natural speed. Stay tightly framed from the black skirt hem to both shoes and the floor. Her black skirt is knee-length, her tights are sheer black nylon with skin visible beneath, and the same closed-toe black block heels stay firmly on her feet.

The low camera tracks parallel beside her at shin height, matching her forward speed. Her legs remain near the same horizontal position while the graphite train and cyan/magenta reflections slide behind her. Show a readable stride cycle: one foot makes a believable contact, supports her weight, and pushes off while the other swings forward. Both legs move with natural knee and ankle articulation. Keep the camera distance and lens constant, with restrained movement from running; no orbit or zoom. Keep her torso and face outside the crop.

Maintain the supplied sheltered futuristic station, damp reflective floor, and diffuse 8:30 a.m. daylight. The train is stationary; its apparent motion comes from the tracking camera. Preserve shoe design, heel thickness, sheer tights, and skirt length. No sliding feet, extra limbs, floating strides, superhuman speed, slow motion, outfit changes, cuts, or overlays.

Native sound: crisp heel contacts synchronized with footfalls, lighter sole contacts between them, subtle skirt movement, quiet breath above the frame, and spacious low station ambience. Running is hurried but human. No music, narration, intelligible announcements, or spoken dialogue. Continue running through the end so the editor can choose a clean cut on a footfall.
